argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue';$out=[ordered]@{checkedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o')};$root='E:\WebAIBridge';$out.bridgePathExists=Test-Path -LiteralPath $root;if($out.bridgePathExists){$out.gitHead=((& git -C $root rev-parse HEAD 2>$null) -join '').Trim();$out.gitBranch=((& git -C $root branch --show-current 2>$null) -join '').Trim();$out.gitDirtyCount=@(git -C $root status --porcelain=v1 -uno 2>$null).Count};$b='http://127.0.0.1:17448';foreach($spec in @(@('health','/api/operator-lifecycle'),@('watchdog','/api/supervisor-watchdog?detect=0'),@('assignments','/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments'),@('managed','/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats'))){$key=$spec[0];try{$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Method GET -Uri ($b+$spec[1]) -TimeoutSec 3;if($key -eq 'health'){$out.health=[ordered]@{mode=$r.mode;revision=$r.revision;queuePaused=$r.queuePaused}}elseif($key -eq 'watchdog'){$out.watchdog=[ordered]@{mode=$r.config.mode;enabled=$r.config.enabled;autoContinue=$r.config.autoContinueEnabled;autonomous=$r.config.allowAutonomousSend;runtimeKeys=@($r.runtime.PSObject.Properties.Name|Select-Object -First 10)}}elseif($key -eq 'assignments'){$out.assignmentCounts=$r.counts}elseif($key -eq 'managed'){$out.chats=@($r.chats|ForEach-Object{[ordered]@{name=$_.name;status=$_.status;highMode=$_.highMode;activeAssignments=$_.activeAssignmentCount;openTabs=$_.openTabs;error=$_.error}})}}catch{$out[$key+'Error']=$_.Exception.GetType().Name}};try{$t=Invoke-RestMethod -Method GET -Uri ($b+'/api/settings') -TimeoutSec 3;$out.settingsKeys=@($t.PSObject.Properties.Name |Select-Object -First 14);$out.telegramSettings=[ordered]@{notifyEnabled=$t.settings.telegramNotifyEnabled;tokenConfigured=$t.settings.telegramBotTokenConfigured;chatConfigured=[bool]($t.settings.telegramChatId);threadConfigured=[bool]($t.settings.telegramThreadId)}}catch{$out.settingsError=$_.Exception.GetType().Name};$out|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 7

note: Read-only, narrow local Bridge+curator and Telegram configured boolean status, Git HEAD/dirty count; never output tokens.
